summary: No services are sold and no advertising accounts are opened here: the site publishes an independent walkthrough of getting started with TikTok Ads, the new advertiser ad credit tiers and campaign setup in Ads Manager.

capabilities.name: Credit tier reference
capabilities.description: Shows the new advertiser spend tiers and the ad credit each tier is associated with, with an explicit not-guaranteed disclaimer.

capabilities.name: Registration walkthrough
capabilities.description: Three steps from creating the account on TikTok to exploring campaign setup, plus what to decide before spending.

capabilities.name: FAQ
capabilities.description: Ten questions on registration, required information, cost, starting with a small budget, what happens after registration, creative format, measurement, credit eligibility and affiliation.

limitations: independent resource, not affiliated with TikTok
